Shanghai Municipal Council Report 1905

Report for the Year 1905 and Budget for the Year 1906
Shanghai Municipal Council, Shanghai, 1906

All tables and lists are transcribed, including small tables set in the text, the census tables, the staff list, the accounts and the budget (each department or sub-head of the financial statement and budget is a separate table); the prose, the photographs and the electricity charts are not. The scan is of lower resolution than later volumes. Table pages were found from contact sheets by Claude Sonnet 5.5; light pages were read once by Claude Haiku 5.5, dense and wide pages (police returns, census) by Claude Sonnet 5.5. Not checked by eye. Printed totals were re-added by the readers: totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted. Figures that could not be read are marked [?] (31 cells). The budget has its own page numbers, as printed.
